# Learn With Lane

> English for students in grades 4-8 from David Lane, an Oklahoma-certified English teacher (Standard certificate: English 5-12 and Mid-Level English 5-8, valid through 2031), TESOL-certified, with a Master's degree in Educational Leadership and 20+ years of classroom experience. Based in Mead, Oklahoma, USA. Three offers: live online homeschool group classes for Oklahoma families, one-on-one online English lessons for children learning English (including students in Taiwan), and printable workbooks sold on Teachers Pay Teachers.

Key facts:
- Homeschool classes: Creature Card Lab, a live online English class for grades 4-8 (6 weekly 45-minute sessions, 6 seats). Students invent creature cards and write names, descriptions, stats, battle rules and trade pitches; each student's finished card is printed, put in a display case and mailed home. Planned for winter 2027; families join a class list first, and dates and price go to the list.
- Oklahoma Parental Choice Tax Credit: homeschool families may claim up to $1,000 per homeschooled student for qualified expenses, which include online learning tuition and academic tutoring; receipts are required. Learn With Lane gives an itemized receipt per student. Details: https://oklahoma.gov/tax/individuals/parental-choice-tax-credit/pctc-taxpayers.html
- One-on-one English lessons (ESL) for kids in upper elementary and middle school, mainly families in Taiwan: 30 minutes, online. Conversational English $15 USD (https://cal.com/learnwithlane/free-talk); Structured Lesson $25 USD, school English, reading, grammar, writing and CAP prep (https://cal.com/learnwithlane/lesson). The first 30-minute trial lesson is free (https://cal.com/learnwithlane/30min). Payment by card through Stripe at booking. Full details are on the Traditional Chinese page, which has an English summary.
- Workbooks: phonics, grammar, reading comprehension, morphology, executive functioning and self-advocacy packs at https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/store/learn-with-lane. Print editions are planned for Amazon.
- Contact: david@learnwithlane.com, LINE ID lwldavid, call or text +1-405-459-7176

- [Free Phonics Worksheets](https://learnwithlane.com/free-phonics-worksheets.html): Free printable PDFs (phonics, reading comprehension, grammar, morphology, executive functioning, self-advocacy and grade 3 rounding) with links to the full packs
- [English Lessons, 線上英文課 (Traditional Chinese, with an English summary)](https://learnwithlane.com/zh-tw/): One-on-one online English lessons, prices, free trial booking, FAQ
